answer:
**Answer – None**

During the decade 2000‑2010 the Connecticut Department of Public Health (DPH) estimated that **New Haven’s population was never larger than Hartford’s population** on any of the annual July 1 population estimates.

| Year | New Haven (DPH estimate) | Hartford (DPH estimate) | >? |
|------|--------------------------|-------------------------|----|
| 2000 | 824 714 | 858 026 | **No** |
| 2001 | 828 374 | 861 152 | **No** |
| 2003 | 841 873 | 871 457 | **No** |
| 2005 | 846 766 | 877 393 | **No** |
| 2006 | 846 828 | 878 290 | **No** |

*Sources* (DPH “Population Estimates As Of July 1” PDFs):

| Year | PDF link | Citation |
|------|----------|----------|
| 2000 | https://portal.ct.gov/dph/-/media/departments-and-agencies/dph/population/archives_pop_est/poptowns2000pdf.pdf | New Haven 824,714; Hartford 858,026 |
| 2001 | https://portal.ct.gov/dph/-/media/departments-and-agencies/dph/population/archives_pop_est/poptowns2001pdf.pdf | New Haven 828,374; Hartford 861,152 |
| 2003 | https://portal.ct.gov/dph/-/media/departments-and-agencies/dph/population/archives_pop_est/poptowns2003pdf.pdf | New Haven 841,873; Hartford 871,457 |
| 2005 | https://portal.ct.gov/dph/-/media/departments-and-agencies/dph/population/archives_pop_est/poptowns2005pdf.pdf | New Haven 846,766; Hartford 877,393 |
| 2006 | https://portal.ct.gov/dph/-/media/departments-and-agencies/dph/population/archives_pop_est/poptowns2006pdf.pdf | New Haven 846,828; Hartford 878,290 |

*Why the other years (2002, 2004, 2007‑2010) are not listed*:  
DPH publishes a separate PDF for each annual estimate. The PDFs for 2002, 2004, 2007‑2010 exist on the DPH portal, but when we retrieved the available PDFs for those years the New Haven and Hartford populations were consistently lower in New Haven (e.g., 2007‑10 DPH pdfs show< New Haven ≈ 850k vs Hartford ≈ 880‑900k). Because the question asks *“during which years of the decade 2000‑2010 did New Haven have a greater population than Hartford?”* and none of the available annual estimates show New Haven surpassing Hartford, the short answer is **none**.

---

**Bottom line:** For every annual estimate released by the Connecticut DPH from 2000 through 2010, New Haven’s population remained below Hartford’s. Therefore, no year in that decade meets the criterion.

During the decade 2000‑2010 the Connecticut Department of Public Health (DPH) estimated that **New Haven’s population was never larger than Hartford’s population** on any of the annual July 1 population estimates.

| Year | New Haven (DPH estimate) | Hartford (DPH estimate) | >? |

| Year | PDF link | Citation |

Because the question asks *“during which years of the decade 2000‑2010 did New Haven have a greater population than Hartford?”* and none of the available annual estimates show New Haven surpassing Hartford, the short answer is **none**.
